name: 58078 · West Fargo, ND
findings: ZIP 58078 (West Fargo) has 110 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 58078 (West Fargo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 58078 (West Fargo) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).
